propositions: Test monolithically iterates all 884 renderable units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns in a single test function, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding the 300s per-test timeout on contended macOS runners.

pytest-timeout's thread method kills the xdist worker process with os._exit(1) when the test budget is exceeded, producing 'node down: Not properly terminated' and worker crash reports without assertion text or traceback.
The test's unbounded cost is load-dependent and corpus-size-dependent, violating the class fix requirement that per-test budget cannot be re-crossed by fixture growth.

Fixing the test requires chunk-parametrization with fixed _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK size to bound per-case cost to ~4s idle with 13x headroom, keeping all 884 units compared and xdist-distributable across workers.
A coverage guard test must verify that all parametrized chunks reassemble to exactly _renderable_units() with total >= 100, ensuring no units are silently dropped by chunking.
